plotSections.title: Kitchen Talk on the Nature of Gods
bullets: In the stronghold kitchen, an NPC voiced by the DM (likely Mahali, the party's elder-god chef) explains to Walker that divinity is built on belief: a single person believing doesn't make someone a god, but a million believers make that belief tangible, the same way belief shifts when a tyrant king is overthrown.

Killing a god is incredibly difficult because you are really killing the belief in them; you must degrade both the god's physical being and its followers, a nasty process spanning many lifetimes, which is why the gods' games are long and arduous.
Gods don't go around announcing themselves, or they attract hangers-on.
Walker claims his questions are just curiosity; the NPC puts him to work chopping carrots and potatoes and has Gerk 'mash' a bucket of raw potatoes, which Gerk does by punching the bucket apart.

plotSections.title: Moxie in Ord's Quarters
bullets: Ord (with Ciri lingering cautiously behind) enters his 20x20 living quarters (three bunk beds, two tables, crates) and hears something scurry away.
A shallow hole in the floor marks where Ponchi started digging a hot tub before stopping; his pickaxe, hammer, maul and metal chisel lie nearby.
In the far right corner sits a roughly three-foot-tall beaver-dam-like nest built largely from a cannibalized third bunk bed, with a door-like opening and a crude handmade sign reading 'Moxie'.

After hissing from inside, a successful animal handling check with food coaxes out Moxie: a bipedal, foot-and-a-half-tall creature like a mix of a beaver (like Mr. Beaver from Narnia) and a wolverine, with amber semi-feline eyes, thick blackish-brown fur, a wide shaggy flat tail that comes to a point, and articulate four-digit hands (thumb plus three) with weasel-like pads.

Ord says he's a friend of Ponchi; Moxie chirps, whistles, and repeats 'Ponchi, hungry, hungry', scoops the food off Ord's hand with paddle-shaped hands, then bounces demanding 'more, more, more'. Ord calls Ciri to bring the scrap bucket, and she gently nudges it toward the creature.

chronologicalEvents: The DM's NPC (likely Mahali) explains to Walker that gods are sustained by belief and that killing one means destroying both its body and its followers over many lifetimes.
The NPC notes gods don't reveal themselves to avoid hangers-on, and asks why Walker is asking; Walker says it's curiosity.
Walker is given carrots and potatoes to chop; Gerk is given a bucket of raw potatoes to mash and punches it, bucket and all, to bits.
Ord enters his quarters cautiously with Ciri behind and finds Ponchi's unfinished hot tub hole and a nest labeled 'Moxie'.
Ord coaxes Moxie out with food via an animal handling check.
Moxie eats from Ord's hand, repeating 'Ponchi, hungry' and asking for more; Ord has Ciri bring the scrap bucket.

Mahali.existing: Elder god serving as the party's chef at the stronghold.
notes: Likely the speaker (voiced by the DM) in the kitchen scene; explains that gods are made tangible by mass belief and are killed by destroying both body and followers over many lifetimes.
Says gods don't announce themselves to avoid hangers-on.
Puts Walker to work chopping vegetables and has Gerk mash raw potatoes.
personality: Speaks in teacherly riddles: 'we don't point out the obvious; you must come to it on your own.'
Practical and a bit wry, putting guests to work.
quotesThemes: Imagine that belief, but a million strong.
You must not only degrade the physical being of the god, but also the followers.
We don't go around telling people that we're gods. Otherwise we get hangers on.
openQuestions: Asked Walker what particular reason he had for asking about gods.

notes: Questioned the chef NPC about what makes a god and how gods can be killed; claimed it was just curiosity.
Helped chop carrots and potatoes in the kitchen.
'Mashed' a bucket of raw potatoes by punching it, smashing the bucket as well.

Ponchi.existing: Stronghold guard who will relocate to the tavern.
notes: Began digging a hot tub in the middle of Ord's quarters (a couple inches deep and wide) and abandoned it, leaving a pickaxe, large hammer, maul and metal chisel.
Linked to Moxie, who repeats his name; Ord claimed Ponchi sent him with food.
Small bipedal creature, about 1.5 ft tall, living in a nest in Ord's quarters built from a cannibalized bunk bed and labeled 'Moxie'.

Looks like a cross between a beaver (like Mr. Beaver from Narnia) and a wolverine: thick blackish-brown fur, wide shaggy flat pointed tail, amber semi-feline eyes, articulate four-digit hands with weasel-like pads.
Can speak a few words ('Ponchi', 'hungry', 'more'), and also hisses, whistles, and chirps like a sparrow.
Eats greedily but in a controlled way, scooping food with paddle-shaped hands.
personality: Suspicious and hissing at first, quickly won over by food.
quotesThemes: Ponchi, hungry, hungry... more, more, more.

notes: Discovered Moxie's nest in his quarters and befriended the creature with food via an animal handling check.
Hung back warily as Ord investigated Moxie, then brought the scrap bucket over.
personality: Curious, but not curious enough to be the one who figures out what the creature is.

newTerms.name: Moxie
notes: Small talking beaver/wolverine-like creature nesting in Ord's quarters, connected to Ponchi.
